vn: TRANG PHỤC CHUẨN TOÀN BỘ 78 LÁ: chỉ là một DẢI LỤA MỎNG quấn ngang hông, che phần hông/đùi trên; có thể kèm dải lụa mỏng lướt qua ngực và tấm voan mỏng bay từ vai. Cấm váy, áo choàng, corset, nịt, giáp, vải dày/mờ. Cơ thể trần ở vai, lưng, eo, hông, chân.
wardrobe_lock: Wardrobe standard (hard rule — identical on every card of this deck): her ONLY garment is a NARROW BAND of fine translucent silk wrapped low across her hips, a hip-sash that covers the pelvis and the tops of the thighs, the silk so thin it clings and lets the line of her body read through it. A second narrow ribbon of the same gossamer silk drifts across her chest, and the same silk may stream from her shoulders or behind her. FORBIDDEN as clothing: gowns, dresses, bodices, corsets, skirts, capes, cloaks, armour, straps, harnesses, thick or opaque cloth, velvet, brocade, layered drapery. The silhouette stays bare and uncluttered — the sensuality comes from skin and the single band of silk, never from clothing. No explicit nudity: no visible breasts or nipples, no buttocks or genitals; the chest ribbon and the hip band always cover those areas. Props, furniture, cushions and thrones are NOT affected by this forbidden list. Any secondary human figure wears the same simple translucent silk — no nude secondary figures anywhere on the card. Bare skin of the shoulders, arms, back, waist, hips and legs is expected and desired; the fabric must read as a whisper of silk, not as clothing.
